clue.text: Canadian region rural paradise Republican deserts

indicators.note: deserts means leaves, so the Republican's letter walks out of the paradise word

parts.note: Arcadia is the pastoral idyll of Greek legend

explanation.surface: A politician abandons an idyllic stretch of Canadian countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Acadia was the colonial French territory in what are now the Maritime provinces of eastern Canada.

clue.text: Lowering second engine cover

parts.note: a cowling is the removable metal casing over an aircraft or car engine

explanation.surface: A mechanic lowers a second hood over the motor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lowering' reads as a verb about moving something down, but it is the adjective (rhymes with 'flowering') meaning frowning or glowering.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowering in its old sense means frowning darkly, a synonym for glowering with a sullen face.

clue.text: Drummer in band old celeb at bar ultimately

parts.note: a ring is a circular band
a celeb, or celebrity, is a star

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word bar

explanation.surface: A drummer in a group spots a fading celebrity at the end of the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: He was the drummer of the Beatles, so a famous example of a drummer.

clue.text: Stick close to concierge in block

indicators.note: in places the final letter of the hotel porter's title within the barrier word

parts.note: a bar blocks the way, as in to bar entry

indicators.note: close to means the end of, here the last letter of concierge

explanation.surface: Someone sticks close to the concierge in an apartment block.
explanation.definitionFit: To stick something is to tolerate it, as in 'I can't stick him', so a synonym.

clue.text: Family outcast threatening animal

parts.note: black skies or looks are threatening and menacing
a sheep is an animal

explanation.surface: The family's disowned member is described as a menacing beast.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the family member regarded as a disgrace and disowned by the rest.

clue.text: Female by meadow in small jumper

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for a meadow

explanation.surface: A woman in a field wears a little sweater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumper' suggests a British sweater; here it is a creature that jumps.
explanation.definitionFit: The parasitic insect is tiny and famous for its enormous leaps.

clue.text: Rock agreeable to an audience

indicators.note: to an audience means as heard by listeners, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: nice means agreeable or pleasant

explanation.surface: Rock music is pleasant to listeners.
explanation.walkthrough: The rock's name is pronounced 'nice', with silent G.
explanation.definitionFit: A coarse banded metamorphic stone, a type of rock.

clue.text: One from hoi polloi more frequently encountered

definitions.meaning: a member of the ordinary people, not of the nobility
the comparative of common, seen more often

explanation.surface: A member of the masses is seen more often.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-aristocrat is one of the ordinary people; also the comparative of common, meaning more usual.

clue.text: Scarlet and black rock enclosing ravine

indicators.note: enclosing means the black rock word wraps around the ravine word

parts.note: coal is a black sedimentary rock
a chine is a deep narrow ravine, especially on the Isle of Wight or Dorset coast

explanation.surface: Red and black stone surrounds a gorge.
explanation.definitionFit: The dye made from crushed insects gives a brilliant red, so the name serves for a scarlet colour.

clue.text: Text shortened, depart peculiar vocabulary

indicators.note: shortened means cut short, losing the final letter of the text word

parts.note: a line is a piece of text, as in a line of a play
to go is to depart

explanation.surface: A message cut short before going, written in odd words.
explanation.definitionFit: Jargon or slang particular to a group, a peculiar vocabulary.

clue.text: Active sort about to shake grand old woman

indicators.note: about means the doer word goes round the shake word

parts.note: a doer is an active person who gets things done
to wag is to shake, as a dog's tail

explanation.surface: An energetic person is about to shake a grand old lady.
explanation.definitionFit: A titled widow holding her late husband's rank, and loosely a dignified elderly lady.

clue.text: Nutcase has stuff about Ulster University

indicators.note: about means the stuff word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: to cram is to stuff
NI, Northern Ireland, is often called Ulster

explanation.surface: A lunatic is cramming about a university in Northern Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nutcase' suggests a madman; it is read literally as the case of the nut, the head.
explanation.definitionFit: The skull encloses the brain, and 'nut' is slang for the head, so it is the head's case.

clue.text: Left cuts first-rate boxer

indicators.note: cuts means the Left letter slices into the first-rate letters

parts.note: A1 is first-rate, written AI in crosswords

explanation.surface: A left jab slices into a first-class fighter.
explanation.definitionFit: Muhammad Ali was a heavyweight boxing champion, an example of a boxer.

clue.text: One working as rep no less

indicators.note: working means the letters are being worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone employed as a sales rep, no less.
explanation.definitionFit: A rep is a sales representative, a person who sells; 'One' stands for that person.

clue.text: One spotted crossing road asleep so needing treatment

indicators.note: crossing means the rearranged letters go across, straddling the road abbreviation
needing treatment means the letters are to be worked on and rearranged

explanation.surface: A pedestrian seen crossing the road while half asleep needs medical help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One spotted' reads as a person noticed, but means an animal with spots. 'needing treatment' gives LEOPAESS, which 'crossing' wraps round the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A female leopard is a big cat with a spotted coat, so one that is spotted.

clue.text: EU partner to bridge gap sooner or later

indicators.note: to bridge means the two letters span either side of the gap word

parts.note: a vent is an opening or gap
an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: A European Union partner will close the gap in time.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: at some later time, in the end, one way or another.

clue.text: Blind faith seen in one having puppies?

definitions.meaning: read as two words, a mother dog, the ma of puppies

explanation.surface: Unthinking faith is found in a pregnant bitch.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of beliefs held without question is unquestioning creed; split, it is also a mother dog.

clue.text: Desert Arab perhaps converted to nudism

indicators.note: converted means changed in form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A desert nomad has taken up naturism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Desert Arab' suggests a Bedouin; here 'desert' is a verb and an Arab is a breed of horse.
explanation.definitionFit: To get off a horse is to abandon, or desert, one's mount, and an Arab is an example of a horse.

clue.text: United were victorious reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said or heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: won means were victorious

explanation.surface: Word is that Manchester United won the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'United' suggests a football club; it is the definition, meaning joined as a single whole.
explanation.definitionFit: People united are at one, joined together as a single whole.

clue.text: Bird shows colour — that is when reflected

indicators.note: when reflected means seen as in a mirror, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: red is a colour
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A bird shows its plumage colour when seen in a mirror.
explanation.definitionFit: A large sea duck prized for its soft down, an example of a bird.

clue.text: Drive away from one small lake in Kansas City

indicators.note: in places the three small pieces within the city name

parts.note: Dodge City is a town in Kansas, famous from Wild West history
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Driving away from a small lake in Kansas City.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kansas City' is not that city but Dodge City, also in Kansas.
explanation.definitionFit: To force someone from a fixed position is to drive them out of it.

clue.text: It protects in covering both flight and landing

definitions.text: It protects in covering both flight and landing

parts.words: It protects in covering both flight and landing
parts.note: flight and landing suggest aircraft, but here they are a set of stairs and the floor at its top

explanation.surface: Something that shields a plane during takeoff and touchdown.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner of carpet laid on the steps and the landing protects and covers both.

clue.text: Stress caused where Bill needs money

parts.note: AC, short for account, is a bill
a cent is a coin, a piece of money

explanation.surface: Anxiety arises when a man named Bill is short of cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name; it is an invoice, an account.
explanation.definitionFit: Emphasis placed on a syllable when speaking is stress, a synonym.

clue.text: Wrestler loses nothing in total

indicators.note: loses means the wrestler word drops the nothing letter

parts.note: a sumo is a Japanese wrestler
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A wrestler loses nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: The result of adding figures together, the total, is a sum.

clue.text: Exact time

definitions.meaning: pronounced my-NEWT, meaning precise and detailed
a sixtieth of an hour, a short period of time

explanation.surface: The precise time.
explanation.definitionFit: Spelt the same, one word means tiny or precise in detail and the other a sixty-second period.

clue.text: Where one finds fruit or vegetable

parts.note: chard is a leafy green vegetable

explanation.surface: A grocer asks where to find fruit or vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit trees are planted together in this enclosure, so it is a place fruit is found.

clue.text: One sax used in national tour

indicators.note: used in means the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A single saxophone is played on a national tour.
explanation.definitionFit: The alto saxophone is a common member of the sax family, an example of one.

clue.text: Soldier feeding egg to fiery monster

indicators.note: feeding means putting the egg letter into the monster word, as food goes in

parts.note: a dragon is a fire-breathing monster
O, shaped like an egg, stands for egg

explanation.surface: A soldier feeds an egg to a fire-breathing beast.
explanation.definitionFit: A mounted infantryman, a type of soldier.

clue.text: Quack to keep ducks closer?

indicators.note: to keep means the doctor's letters hold the duck letters within them

parts.note: a quack is a doctor, abbreviated DR
a duck is a zero in cricket, O, so ducks are OO

explanation.surface: A duck's quack keeps the flock nearer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quack' looks like a duck's call next to 'ducks', but it is a doctor; 'closer' is one that closes.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinged panel shuts a room, so it is literally a thing that closes; the question mark flags the wordplay.

clue.text: Conservationists engaging a certain ensemble

indicators.note: engaging means taking in, so the conservation charity's letters hold the other piece

parts.note: NT is the National Trust, a British heritage conservation charity
a certain person can be put as one, as in 'one Mr Smith'

explanation.surface: Conservation workers hire a particular band.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of nine musicians, a kind of musical ensemble.

clue.text: Modest accepting trophy and fame

indicators.note: accepting means the modest word takes in the trophy word

parts.note: slight means modest or small
a pot is slang for a trophy cup

explanation.surface: A humble winner accepts the cup and celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in public attention, the focus of fame; the stage light is a figure for celebrity.
